title: 10 Billion LEGO Minifigures Now Outnumber Humans
hook: 10 billion LEGO minifigures now outnumber humanity.
closing: Plastic people already outnumber real ones, and production keeps widening the gap.
question: How many minifigures do you own?

segments.say: LEGO has made 10 billion minifigures. The plastic population now exceeds humanity.
Cumulative production reached 10 billion by 2023. The pile more than doubled in little over a decade.
LEGO makes 400 million minifigures yearly. Plastic people arrive much faster than babies.
